name: @mlightcad/libredwg-web
description: A DWG/DXF JavaScript parser based on libredwg
author: MLight Lee <mlight.lee@outlook.com>

scripts.build:obj:64: cd ../../build-wasm64 && emmake make clean && emmake make CFLAGS="-O2 -sUSE_ZLIB=1 -DNDEBUG -sMEMORY64 -Wno-limited-postlink-optimizations -Wno-cast-align" LDFLAGS="-sMEMORY64"
scripts.build:wasm:32: cd ../../build-wasm && emcc ../bindings/javascript/embind/*.cpp src/.libs/libredwg.a -O2 -lembind -std=c++17 -Isrc -I../src -I../include -o libredwg-web.js -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s INITIAL_MEMORY=1GB -s MAXIMUM_MEMORY=4GB -s STACK_SIZE=8388608 -s MALLOC=mimalloc -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_NAME="createModule" -sEXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS=FS,ENV,ccall,cwrap,UTF8ToString,stringToNewUTF8,setValue --emit-tsd libredwg-web.d.ts
scripts.build:wasm:64: cd ../../build-wasm64 && emcc ../bindings/javascript/embind/*.cpp src/.libs/libredwg.a -O2 -lembind -std=c++17 -Isrc -I../src -I../include -o libredwg-web.js -s MEMORY64=1 -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s INITIAL_MEMORY=2GB -s MAXIMUM_MEMORY=16GB -s STACK_SIZE=8388608 -s MALLOC=mimalloc -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_NAME="createModule" -sEXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS=FS,ENV,ccall,cwrap,UTF8ToString,stringToNewUTF8,setValue --emit-tsd libredwg-web.d.ts
scripts.build: pnpm build:32 && pnpm build:64 && node script/sync-examples.js
scripts.build:all:32: pnpm build:obj:32 && pnpm build:wasm:32 && pnpm copy:32 && pnpm build:32 && node script/sync-examples.js
scripts.build:all:64: pnpm build:obj:64 && pnpm build:wasm:64 && pnpm copy:64 && pnpm build:64 && node script/sync-examples.js
